support_liam: FYI — ClipCart opened a dispute: they say last week's invoice shows ~2x tokens during nightly window (02:00-03:00 UTC). They provided logs + invoice PDF. Claiming major overcharge.

jason_finance: Can you paste the invoice ID and the customer's account id? I'll flag for provisional credit if we confirm a metering bug.

support_liam: Invoice ID: INV-2026-CC-7781, account: acct_clipcart_42. Attached excerpt: "token_count: 18,954,232 (expected ~9.4M)". They included request ids: r_0a1b2c3.. r_0a1b2c4..

alex_sre: @support_liam assigning to eng + infra. First guess: nightly batching job might have retried and doubled ingestion for that time slice. Can you share the raw request ids & approximate timestamps?

support_liam: Pasted sample request ids in the ticket. Timestamps cluster: 2026-02-15T02:03:10Z -> 02:07:02Z.

marta_ml: On model-serving side we had a patch that changed batching TTL for prefix cache (PR #924). I don't think it would double-count tokens, but if KV keys were regenerated on retry we could create duplicate tokenization records. Need request ids + worker logs.

sre_jen: Checking ingestion pipeline (message-queue dedupe module). I see a lag spike at 02:01 UTC and an acknowledgment retry flood from worker-3. Logs: ```2026-02-15T02:02:58Z WARN ack_timeout for msg 0x7f8a, retrying commit``` That correlates.

alex_sre: If ack retries re-enqueued the same payload but a consumer failed to dedupe by request_id (edge-case: missing request_id header), tokens would be counted twice. Do we have a missing-header incident?

dev-billing-bot: [alert] ledger-ingest: duplicate-detection disabled for window 2026-02-15T02:00:00Z -> 02:15:00Z due to hot-restart. Flag ID: LGD-2026-02-15-013.

marta_ml: That LGD flag explains it. Hot-restart cleared dedupe index; consumers retried and tokens consumed during replays were re-recorded. Root cause: dedupe snapshot not restored after rolling restart.

jason_finance: Thanks. Next steps: (1) Support to propose provisional credit to customer for the overcount; (2) Finance to create revrec adjustment note; (3) Eng to fix restore path and add automated check. I'll draft credit amount — can we get exact overcount delta?

support_liam: Manual diff on ledger shows billed tokens 18,954,232 vs expected 9,477,121 -> delta 9,477,111 tokens. Customer tier rate $0.0004/token => overcharge ~$3,790.84. Submitted provisional credit request.

jason_finance: Provisional credit issued: $3,791 (rounded) to acct_clipcart_42. Revrec note: REV-2026-BILL-032, reason: duplicate-ledger-ingest during hot-restart. Please include this thread in finance ticket.

alex_sre: Eng action items: add preflight dedupe snapshot verification, add alert for LGD flags, and run one-off reconciliation to reconcile any other accounts in that window. I'll open ENG-1257.

sre_jen: Done — ENG-1257 created with owner @alex_sre. Also pushed a safe-guard to re-enable dedupe index restore on hot-restart.

support_liam: Notified ClipCart of provisional credit and timeline for final adjustment after reconciliation. They replied :thumbsup:. Closing for now but keeping monitoring open until reconciliation completes.
